awards.name: Water Explorer Award
awards.purpose: Recognises swimmers who have developed early water confidence and comfort, and are ready to progress into structured learn-to-swim programmes.
criteria: Blow bubbles with face comfortably in the water for at least 5 seconds
Float independently (front or back) for at least 5 seconds
Willingness to place face in water
Readiness to progress into ApeCore™ Learn-to-Swim

awards.name: ApeCore Ready Award
awards.purpose: Recognises swimmers who have developed stronger independence, control, and foundational movement skills in the water, and are ready for assessment-based progression.
criteria: Blow bubbles and hold breath with face in water for at least 5 seconds
Front float and back float independently for at least 5 seconds each
Streamline rocket kicks for at least 2 metres independently and comfortably
Strong foundation in water confidence and independence
Consistent body control and propulsion skills
Readiness to progress into SwimSafer® 2.0 Stage 1
